findings.text: The docs model card is a product page (specs, features, retirement), not a safety or evaluation report.

source.quote: Our cutting-edge language model for coding. Codestral specializes in low-latency, high-frequency tasks such as fill-in-the-middle (FIM), code correction and test generation.

findings.text: The card lists API alias codestral-2501 for this Codestral 2501 release.
The model is retired; the page tells users to use Codestral for new integrations, with retirement date 11/30/2025.

source.quote: This model is retired. Use Codestral for new integrations.

findings.text: Supported product features on the card include fill-in-the-middle (FIM) completions, structured outputs, function calling, predicted outputs, document question and answer (QnA), prefix, batching, and chat completions.

notes: Source is the Mistral Docs model page (https://docs.mistral.ai/models/model-cards/codestral-25-01). Product/catalog page only: header date January 13, 2025, 128k context, text modalities, retirement 11/30/2025, feature list. No Weights table, license, params, risk tiers, safety topics, or numeric eval tables. Modalities from tooltip labels in page RSC: Text input, Text output (no image). licenses array empty in page payload (Premier badge). Blog link https://mistral.ai/news/codestral-2501 is seeded as mistral-codestral-2501-blog (separate document/card key); seed-lookup for this card listed only this system-card document, so blog benchmarks (HumanEval, MBPP, CruxEval, LiveCodeBench, RepoBench, Spider, CanItEdit, HumanEvalFIM) were not included. alsoDocuments empty. No pageCount (web page).
